text: The tool output shows that the property did not meet the criteria for deforestation in 2020. The 67.7 ha of tree loss reported for 2020 falls outside the claim interval (post-baseline), meaning it occurred before the reference date of December 31, 2020. Additionally, while the University of Maryland (Hansen/UMD) data detected this loss, the JRC 2020 reference dataset—required for corroboration—shows **zero forest cover** in 2020, implying the area was already deforested or degraded by that time. The corroboration rule was not met (no agreement on ≥50% of the event area). Thus, the loss in 2020 does not qualify as deforestation under the claim’s conditions.
